title: Joel And I — EN/JA/AR/ZH — Chas Lessons #3 (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar Japanese Arabic Mandarin language learning dry wit deadpan 104bpm upright bass brushed snare multilingual grammar lesson character portrait warm collectivist
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
Swan River. One sentence. Permanent.
"Oh — you mean Joel and I."
Not a lecture. Just the correction. Clean.
Language is character in advance.

[Verse 2 - Japanese, with English translations]
ジョエルと私 (Joel and I)
私ではなく、ジョエルと私 (Not I, but Joel and I)
もう一つの名前を取り除いて (Remove the other name)
残ったものを読んでください (And read what's left)
「水へ行く」— 正しい (I am going to the water — correct)
言葉の順番は (The order of your words)
優先順位の順番です (Is the order of your priorities)
言語の中で自分を最後にする (Put yourself last in language)
日本語は、この知恵を文法に組み込んでいます (Japanese builds this wisdom into grammar itself)

[Chorus - Arabic, with English translations]
جويل وأنا (Joel and I)
وَأنا في النهاية دائماً (And I always goes last)
احذف الاسم الآخر واقرأ ما تبقى (Remove the other name and read what remains)
"أنا ذاهب إلى الماء" — صحيح (I am going to the water — correct)
إذن هو جويل وأنا (So it's Joel and I)
ترتيب كلماتك (The order of your words)
هو ترتيب أولوياتك (Is the order of your priorities)
ضع نفسك في الأخير (Put yourself last)
وشيء ما يتغير (And something shifts)

[Bridge - all three + Mandarin]
English: Language is character in advance
Japanese: 言語は、先取りされた人格です (Language is character in advance)
Arabic: اللغة هي الشخصية مسبقاً (Language is character in advance)
Mandarin: 乔尔和我 — 语言是提前展现的品格 (Joel and I — language is character in advance)

[Outro - all four]
English: Joel and I — one sentence — permanent
Japanese: ジョエルと私 — 一つの言葉 — 永遠 (Joel and I — one word — forever)
Arabic: جويل وأنا — جملة واحدة — دائمة (Joel and I — one sentence — permanent)
Mandarin: 乔尔和我 — 一句话 — 永久 (Joel and I — one sentence — permanent)
